question: restaurants inside building footprints
sql: SELECT p.id, p.names.primary AS place_name, b.id AS building_id FROM lisbon_places p JOIN lisbon_buildings b ON ST_Within(p.geometry, b.geometry) WHERE p.basic_category = 'restaurant' LIMIT 100

question: beauty services in residential buildings
sql: SELECT p.id, p.names.primary AS place_name, b.id AS building_id, b.class FROM lisbon_places p JOIN lisbon_buildings b ON ST_Within(p.geometry, b.geometry) WHERE p.basic_category = 'personal_or_beauty_service' AND b.subtype = 'residential' LIMIT 100

question: historic sites contained by buildings
sql: SELECT p.id, p.names.primary AS place_name, b.id AS building_id FROM lisbon_places p JOIN lisbon_buildings b ON ST_Contains(b.geometry, p.geometry) WHERE p.taxonomy.primary = 'historic_site' LIMIT 100

question: wellness services intersecting commercial buildings
sql: SELECT p.id, p.names.primary AS place_name, b.id AS building_id FROM lisbon_places p JOIN lisbon_buildings b ON ST_Intersects(p.geometry, b.geometry) WHERE p.basic_category = 'wellness_service' AND b.subtype = 'commercial' LIMIT 100

question: fashion stores inside commercial buildings footprints
sql: SELECT b.id, b.class, ST_AsGeoJSON(b.geometry) AS footprint FROM lisbon_buildings b JOIN lisbon_places p ON ST_Contains(b.geometry, p.geometry) WHERE p.basic_category = 'fashion_and_apparel_store' AND b.subtype = 'commercial' LIMIT 100

question: residential buildings touching adjacent residential buildings
sql: SELECT a.id AS building_a, b.id AS building_b FROM lisbon_buildings a JOIN lisbon_buildings b ON ST_Touches(a.geometry, b.geometry) WHERE a.subtype = 'residential' AND b.subtype = 'residential' AND a.id < b.id LIMIT 100
